2b48767adb8cf497d8ea235e224cde9d4fa2af04.summary: Describes Carbanak, an APT-style campaign that targets financial institutions and was discovered in 2014 by Kaspersky Lab. It uses malware delivered by phishing emails to steal money from banks, with the group said to have stolen over 900 million dollars. Targets named include Russia, the United States, Germany, China and Ukraine. FireEye tracked the group as FIN7 and Proofpoint linked it to the Bateleur backdoor. Europol claimed an arrest in 2018. Group-IB, Fox-IT, FBI/USSS and US banking groups disputed the scale of losses outside Russia and Ukraine. No CVEs are named.
